description: List saved Beacons for the authenticated account, including starter Beacons (tag 'starter'). Call at session start to see what is already watched. Each item carries dashboard_url, a private link that opens only for signed-in members of the owning org. Pass beacon_id to read one Beacon's full settings and its revision. USE THIS WHEN: the user asks what Beacons exist, needs a beacon_id, or you must read a Beacon before you edit it. DO NOT USE THIS WHEN: the user wants to run Beacon content; use synorb-manifests with beacon_id.

api_key.description: Synorb key; only if the Authorization header is not set. Tool arguments may be logged.
api_key.title: Api Key

beacon_id.description: Read one Beacon's full settings by id.
beacon_id.title: Beacon Id

offset.description: Number of Beacons to skip, for paging past the first page; default 0. Use next_offset from the previous result.
offset.title: Offset

q.description: Substring search across Beacon name and description; empty string means no text filter.
q.title: Q

name: synorb-beacons

outputSchema.description: Permissive advertised schema for saved Beacon inventory.
outputSchema.title: StreamConfigsInventoryOutput

title: List Beacons
